name: Autopilot lanes (unattended multi-model work queue)
summary: a skill for sittings the owner has declared unattended: the strongest model scopes in-flight work into three lanes by model tier, writes one append-only queue file outside the repository that parallel sessions share, and every session works its own lane behind an inclusion test, an owner-only list that turns into ACTION lines, pathspec-only commits and a rule that only Lane A closes
requires: a project instruction file that names the model-tier policy, the owner-only classes, the session-start health check and the closeout ritual
a project tracker and continuity files to scope from (the closeout-continuity pattern produces them)
retires: the per-item 'what next?' turn and the per-item approval during a sitting the owner has declared unattended
